premise.claim: Stateful selective scale-down is needed for node failures, machine relocation, and application migration... RBG supports ordinary stateful scale-down by reducing replicas. Stateless RoleInstanceSet has a specified-delete flow, but Stateful mode does not expose persistent ordinal retirement. (issue #499)
